clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath Orgrimmar, Taragaman the Hungerer prowls the molten caverns of Ragefire Chasm. The Horde seeks to destroy the hulking felguard, feared as the demonic master behind the Searing Blade cult, and end the demonic taint beneath the city.

Taragaman the Hungerer prowls among Ragefire Chasm's magma pools, threatening Orgrimmar below. Scouts and young warriors sent into the dark caverns see the demonic felguard as the Searing Blade cult's leader. With infernal strength, he bends the weak-willed and corrupts the passages beneath Thrall's fortress.
